name: harness-eval-dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) at the exact pin, installed under /opt/harness/dsh with npm ci from package-lock.json, so every transitive package is fixed by version and integrity. allowScripts runs the install scripts of the three packages whose native pieces dsh needs (node-pty's spawn helper bit, koffi's prebuilt binary, which the Landlock sandbox runner loads) and skips the two that only print or check versions.
